thread:
Eli: quick postmortem follow-up  we need a tight owners+timeline plan to cut pager noise for transient infra spikes. Focus: sensible thresholds, short suppressions, dedupe windows, and a verification checklist. Short bullets please.

Sam: I'll own storage-iops alerts (stor-iops-*). Plan: increase threshold ~20% for short windows, add 4m burst suppression during deploy windows, and canary in staging. Target: canary Tue EOD, prod Thu AM with 48h monitoring.

Priya: I'll update the paging policy and runbook: P0/P1 always page; P2 -> ticket unless tagged customer-impact. Adding a "suppression review" checklist and rollback clause. PR Wed.

Sam: quick smoke harness I'll run in staging:

```
# staging spike: 120 quick requests
seq 1 120 | xargs -n1 -P30 curl -fsS https://staging/storage/health || echo spike
```

Infra-Tool: created task INFR-3120 "stor alert tuning: thresholds + suppression" assigned to Sam, due 2026-04-08.

Eli: dedupe proposal: default dedupe 9m for metric flaps, plus escalation if suppressed_count >= 3 in 90m -> force a page. Also auto-revert suppression if evidence shows >1 true-positive hidden in 24h. Thoughts?

Sam: sounds good. I'll wire the auto-revert metric and add dashboards to the task. Will coordinate with alert-exporter team for compatibility.

Priya: timeline recap: Sam canary Tue EOD; prod Thu AM with 48h monitor; Priya runbook Wed. Please add verification notes to INFR-3120 before close (canary logs, pages vs baseline, customer error check).

oncall-bot: added comment to INFR-3120: "verification checklist required before close."

Eli: thanks all. I'll notify PM and Support with the list of alerts we'll change and tag @incident-review for visibility. End.
